onboardingHeading.message: Set up your workspace in one minute

onboardingLead.message: BookmarkFlow reads your own Chrome Bookmark Bar. Bookmark content never leaves your browser.

dataConsentHeading.message: Choose whether to enable bookmark and page access

dataConsentIntro.message: BookmarkFlow stays off until you agree. If enabled, it handles the following data only to provide its bookmark workspace:

dataConsentBookmarks.message: Bookmark titles, URLs, folders, and favicons are read from Chrome and changed only after your actions.

dataConsentPageContext.message: On regular websites, the current URL, title, and limited layout context are processed locally for matching, visibility, and non-overlapping placement.

dataConsentStorage.message: Display settings may use Chrome Sync; per-site, pinned-folder, and folder-color choices stay in local Chrome storage.

dataConsentSearch.message: A new-tab search is sent by Chrome to your selected default search provider only after you submit it.

dataConsentNoDeveloperCollection.message: Maprins Games does not receive bookmark, page, preference, or search data. There are no analytics, ads, or data sales.

dataConsentAgree.message: I agree — enable bookmark and page access

dataConsentAccepted.message: Privacy choice saved. Bookmark and page access is now enabled.

dataConsentDeclined.message: Bookmark and page access remains off. You can return to this setup guide later.

dataConsentRequired.message: Bookmark and page access is off until the first-run privacy choice is accepted.

dataConsentRequiredHeading.message: Review privacy choices to enable BookmarkFlow

dataConsentRequiredDescription.message: Bookmark and page access remains off until you review the first-run disclosure and agree.

dataConsentUpdateDenied.message: Only BookmarkFlow's setup page can change this privacy choice.

bookmarkBarNoImport.message: No separate import is needed; BookmarkFlow uses your existing Chrome bookmarks.

localSettingsDescription.message: Display, color, and per-site visibility settings stay in Chrome storage.

keyboardReadyDescription.message: Search, visibility, and streamer mode are available from keyboard shortcuts.

disableNativeBarDescription.message: BookmarkFlow cannot change Chrome’s own interface. If the native bookmarks bar is visible, right-click it and turn off “Show bookmarks bar,” or use <kbd>Ctrl + Shift + B</kbd>.

braveNativeBarDescription.message: In Brave, if the shortcut is not enough, open Settings > Appearance > Show bookmarks and choose Never. “Only on new tab page” keeps the native bar visible on new tabs.

nativeBarSafeDescription.message: This does not delete bookmarks. BookmarkFlow continues reading the same Bookmark Bar data.
